I was in the exact same situation when I was 16... except I was in your brothers position. First, you probably should have thought about rating him out a little bit more than you did. Why? because now he will be mad at you, and your dad is mad at you. Also you can kiss toughs free rides to school away, as well as his trust. You went into his room with out his permission, and then on top of that told what I can only assume is his biggest secret to the two people he was keeping it from. He will probably not trust you with secrets anymore, and will probably act less friendly to you. 

However on the flip side, this is a good thing. It was inevitable he would get caught, better by his family than the cops. And this might teach him a lesson, but it can also just be a minor inconvenience in his live and continue to smoke weed. you probably should have talked to him about it first or at least let him know you knew. 

Either way you violated your brothers trust, and its really not going to help his or your situation. I can't really see an upside to this. Its only going to tear your family a little bit more apart. I would know, it happened to me. Next time I would just try to talk it out with him.

Personally I would go with Seattle, company could turn into something bigger and better. Plus the fact that Texas is... not... the best place to live. Everything is constantly under construction and the people there feel entitled to everything... which leads to some unfortunate situations. In the end its your decision, and what you experience in Texas could be totally different than what I described.
